paragraphs.text: translated by
1. Two perfect springs of heat pervade the Threefold, and come for their delight is Matarisvan.
paragraphs.original: घर्मा समन्ता त्रिवृतं व्यापतुस्तयोर्जुष्टिं मातरिश्वा जगाम ।
paragraphs.translit: gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vyāpatustayorjuṣṭiṃ mātariśvā jagāma |

paragraphs.text: Craving the milk of heaven the Gods are present: well do they know the praisesong and the Saman.
paragraphs.original: दिवस्पयो दिधिषाणा अवेषन्विदुर्देवाः सहसामानमर्कम्
paragraphs.translit: divaspayo didhiṣāṇā aveṣanvidurdevāḥ sahasāmānamarkam

paragraphs.text: 2. The priests beard far away, as they are ordered, serve the three Nirrtis, for well they know them.
paragraphs.original: तिस्रो देष्ट्राय निरृतीरुपासते दीर्घश्रुतो वि हि जानन्ति वह्नयः ।
paragraphs.translit: tisro deṣṭrāya nirṛtīrupāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Sages have traced the cause that first produced them, dwelling in distant and mysterious chambers.
paragraphs.original: तासां नि चिक्युः कवयो निदानं परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु
paragraphs.translit: tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānaṃ pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu

paragraphs.text: 3. The Youthful One, well-shaped, with four locks braided, brightened with oil, puts on the ordinances.
paragraphs.original: चतुष्कपर्दा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते ।
paragraphs.translit: catuṣkapardā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste |

paragraphs.text: Two Birds of mighty power are seated near her, there where the Deities receive their portion.
paragraphs.original: तस्यां सुपर्णा वृषणा नि षेदतुर्यत्र देवा दधिरे भागधेयम्
paragraphs.translit: tasyāṃ suparṇā vṛṣaṇā ni ṣedaturyatra devā dadhire bhāgadheyam

paragraphs.text: 4. One of these Birds hath passed into the sea of air: thence he looks round and views this universal world.
paragraphs.original: एकः सुपर्णः स समुद्रमा विवेश स इदं विश्वं भुवनं वि चष्टे ।
paragraphs.translit: ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe |

paragraphs.text: With simple heart I have beheld him from anear: his Mother kisses him and he returns her kiss.
paragraphs.original: तं पाकेन मनसापश्यमन्तितस्तं माता रेळ्हि स उ रेळ्हि मातरम्
paragraphs.translit: taṃ pākena manasāpaśyamantitastaṃ mātā reḷhi sa u reḷhi mātaram

paragraphs.text: 5. Him with fair wings though only One in nature, wise singers shape, with songs, in many figures.
paragraphs.original: सुपर्णं विप्राः कवयो वचोभिरेकं सन्तं बहुधा कल्पयन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti |

paragraphs.text: While they at sacrifices fix the metres, they measure out twelve chalices of Soma.
paragraphs.original: छन्दांसि च दधतो अध्वरेषु ग्रहान्सोमस्य मिमते द्वादश
paragraphs.translit: chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahānsomasya mimate dvādaśa

paragraphs.text: 6. While they arrange the four and six-and-thirty, and duly order, up to twelve, the measures,
paragraphs.original: षट्त्रिंशाँश्च चतुरः कल्पयन्तश्छन्दांसि च दधत आद्वादशम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ṣaṭtriṃśām̐śca caturaḥ kalpayantaśchandāṃsi ca dadhata ādvādaśam |

paragraphs.text: Having disposed the sacrifice thoughtful sages send the Car forward with the Rc and Saman.
paragraphs.original: यज्ञं विमाय कवयो मनीष ऋक्सामाभ्यां प्र रथं वर्तयन्ति
paragraphs.translit: yajñaṃ vimāya kavayo manīṣa ṛksāmābhyāṃ pra rathaṃ vartayanti

paragraphs.text: 7. The Chariot's majesties are fourteen others: seven sages lead it onward with their Voices.
paragraphs.original: चतुर्दशान्ये महिमानो अस्य तं धीरा वाचा प्र णयन्ति सप्त ।
paragraphs.translit: caturdaśānye mahimāno asya taṃ dhīrā vācā pra ṇayanti sapta |

paragraphs.text: Who will declare to us the ford Apnana, the path whereby they drink first draughts of Soma?
paragraphs.original: आप्नानं तीर्थं क इह प्र वोचद्येन पथा प्रपिबन्ते सुतस्य
paragraphs.translit: āpnānaṃ tīrthaṃ ka iha pra vocadyena pathā prapibante sutasya

paragraphs.text: 8. The fifteen lauds are in a thousand places that is as vast as heaven and earth in measure.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रधा पञ्चदशान्युक्था यावद्द्यावापृथिवी तावदित्तत् ।
paragraphs.translit: sahasradhā pañcadaśānyukthā yāvaddyāvāpṛthivī tāvadittat |

paragraphs.text: A thousand spots contain the mighty thousand. Vak spreadeth forth as far as Prayer extendeth.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रधा महिमानः सहस्रं यावद्ब्रह्म विष्ठितं तावती वाक्
paragraphs.translit: sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasraṃ yāvadbrahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāk

paragraphs.text: 9. What sage hath learned the metres' application? Who hath gained Vak, the spirit's aim and object?
paragraphs.original: कश्छन्दसां योगमावेद धीरः को धिष्ण्यां प्रति वाचं पपाद ।
paragraphs.translit: kaśchandasāṃ yogamāveda dhīraḥ ko dhiṣṇyāṃ prati vācaṃ papāda |

paragraphs.text: Which ministering priest is called eighth Hero? Who then hath tracked the two Bay Steeds of Indra?
paragraphs.original: कमृत्विजामष्टमं शूरमाहुर्हरी इन्द्रस्य नि चिकाय कः स्वित्
paragraphs.translit: kamṛtvijāmaṣṭamaṃ śūramāhurharī indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit

paragraphs.text: 10. Yoked to his chariot-pole there stood the Coursers: they only travel round earth's farthest limits.
paragraphs.original: भूम्या अन्तं पर्येके चरन्ति रथस्य धूर्षु युक्तासो अस्थुः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhūmyā antaṃ paryeke caranti rathasya dhūrṣu yuktāso asthuḥ |

paragraphs.text: These, when their driver in his home is settled, receive the allotted meed of their exertion.
paragraphs.original: श्रमस्य दायं वि भजन्त्येभ्यो यदा यमो भवति हर्म्ये हितः
paragraphs.translit: śramasya dāyaṃ vi bhajantyebhyo yadā yamo bhavati harmye hitaḥ
